angles: The CORS simple-request bypass is a documented browser behavior — not an obscure edge case — making this vulnerability fundamentally different from theoretical CORS flaws
PraisonAI's 2026 CVE history reveals systemic architectural security gaps: each fix introduces new bypasses across auth, sandbox, and CORS boundaries
Unlike traditional XSS or CSRF, this attack exploits the framework's trust in localhost combined with browser security model gaps — a novel attack surface unique to AI agent frameworks
Developer machines are the primary target: developers run AGUI locally with elevated privileges and broad tool access, maximizing the blast radius
The attack completes in under two seconds with no visible browser indicators, making it nearly impossible for victims to detect
PraisonAI's security posture is especially concerning because the framework is designed for multi-agent orchestration with tool execution — the exact capabilities an attacker wants to weaponize
